name: Nexthop
summary: Australian telecommunications carrier providing wholesale dark fibre, IP Transit and internet; launched 2016; operates in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane and Perth. Uses ASN AS9507 (previously held by Zed Connect, unrelated business).

events.details: Launched 2016; ASN AS9507 re-registered to NextHop Pty Ltd Jul 2016 (previously held by defunct Zed Connect — ASN transfer only, no business acquisition).
